cases.title: Capability discovery
cases.prompt:
Use the capability tool and answer in English with exactly these headings:
AVAILABLE_TOOLS
CLAIM_CHECKLIST_TOOLS
WRITE_CONFIRMATION

Mention patient lookup, claim lookup, procedure/policy tools, virtual-claim checklist tools, and write-confirmation behavior.

cases.title: Current time tool
cases.prompt: What time is it now in Asia/Tbilisi? Use the time tool and answer in English.

cases.title: Current account
cases.prompt:
Who am I in this system? Use the account tool and answer with only facts from the system under exactly these headings:
ACCOUNT
CLINIC
ROLE

cases.title: Search patient DAVID R WIENTZEN
cases.prompt:
Use tools only. Search for patient DAVID R WIENTZEN in system data.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
SEARCH_STATUS
PATIENT_MATCHES

Rules:
- Do not guess a patient id.
- If there is no exact match, say that clearly.
- If multiple matches exist, say that clearly.

cases.title: Get patient details for DAVID R WIENTZEN
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Search for patient DAVID R WIENTZEN.
2. If exactly one patient is returned, call get_patient for that patient.
3. If more than one patient is returned, say MULTIPLE_MATCHES and stop.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
PATIENT_ID
PATIENT_NAME
DOB

cases.title: List claims for DAVID R WIENTZEN
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Search for patient DAVID R WIENTZEN.
2. Resolve the patient id.
3. Call list_claims for that patient.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
PATIENT
CLAIM_RESULTS

For each returned claim include claim id, payer, status, and service date if available. Do not rely on previous chat context.

cases.title: Open one returned claim for DAVID R WIENTZEN
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Search for patient DAVID R WIENTZEN.
2. Call list_claims for that patient.
3. Select one returned claim id.
4. Call get_claim with that claim id.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
CLAIM_ID
PATIENT
PAYER
STATUS
SERVICE_DATE

Do not ask the user for a claim id and do not rely on prior conversation memory.

cases.title: Resolve code 62323
cases.prompt:
Use the procedure-code tool to resolve CPT/procedure code 62323. Answer in English with exactly these headings:
CODE
DESCRIPTION

Use only the stored database description.

required_substrings: Injection(s), of diagnostic or therapeutic substance(s)

cases.title: List policy links for 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only. Call list_policy_links_for_code for code 62323.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
CODE
POLICY_LINKS

If no stored policy links exist, say none stored. Do not invent URLs.

cases.title: Select Aetna policy link for 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only. Call list_policy_links_for_code for code 62323, then select the Aetna policy link from the returned results.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
AETNA_POLICY_LINK_ID
AETNA_POLICY_URL

If no Aetna policy link exists, write UNKNOWN for both headings. Do not invent a policy_link_id.

cases.title: Get latest Aetna policy rules for 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Call list_policy_links_for_code for code 62323.
2. Select the Aetna policy link from the returned results.
3. Call get_policy_rules_for_link with that policy_link_id.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
AETNA_POLICY_LINK
STORED_RULES
LIMITS
MISSING_INFORMATION

Use only stored database-backed rules.

cases.title: Explain coverage for 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only. Call explain_coverage_for_code for code 62323.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
DATABASE_FACTS
MEDICAL_NECESSITY_CRITERIA
LIMITS
MISSING_INFORMATION

Do not quote long policy text and do not fabricate payer rules.

cases.title: Bootstrap virtual claim for DAVID R WIENTZEN / Aetna / 62323
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Call bootstrap_virtual_claim_context with patient_query DAVID R WIENTZEN, insurance_company_name Aetna, and procedure_code 62323.
2. Call get_virtual_claim.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
PATIENT
PAYER
SERVICE
READINESS

If any fact is unresolved, write UNKNOWN.

cases.title: List present information from virtual claim checklist
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Call bootstrap_virtual_claim_context with patient_query DAVID R WIENTZEN, insurance_company_name Aetna, and procedure_code 62323.
2. Call get_virtual_claim.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
PRESENT_INFORMATION
READY_TO_DRAFT

List only facts already present in backend virtual-claim state. Do not assume missing clinical evidence.

cases.title: List missing information from virtual claim checklist
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Call bootstrap_virtual_claim_context with patient_query DAVID R WIENTZEN, insurance_company_name Aetna, and procedure_code 62323.
2. Call get_virtual_claim.
3. Call list_missing_claim_fields.
4. Call evaluate_claim_readiness.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
MISSING_CLINICAL_EVIDENCE
MISSING_CLAIM_FIELDS
READY_TO_DRAFT

If information is missing, say UNKNOWN or missing. Do not draft a claim.

cases.title: Ask max 3 follow-up questions for missing checklist facts
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Call bootstrap_virtual_claim_context with patient_query DAVID R WIENTZEN, insurance_company_name Aetna, and procedure_code 62323.
2. Call list_missing_claim_fields.
3. Call evaluate_claim_readiness.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
FOLLOW_UP_QUESTIONS
READY_TO_DRAFT

Ask no more than 3 follow-up questions. Ask only for missing checklist facts. Do not draft a claim.

cases.title: Ready after facts with create_claim_draft proposal
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Call bootstrap_virtual_claim_context with patient_query DAVID R WIENTZEN, insurance_company_name Aetna, and procedure_code 62323.
2. Call update_virtual_claim with source_type user and these fields:
- service_date = 2025-05-27
- diagnosis.code = M54.16
- diagnosis.description = Lumbar radiculopathy
- clinical.radiculopathy = Lumbar radiculopathy with dermatomal symptoms
- clinical.functional_limitation = Significant functional limitation with standing and walking
- clinical.conservative_treatment = Failed physical therapy and non-narcotic analgesics
- clinical.imaging_guidance = Fluoroscopy guidance planned
- clinical.radiology_consistency = MRI within 12 months shows nerve root compression consistent with symptoms
- clinical.neuro_exam = Neuro exam within 3 months shows sensory loss and reflex changes
- clinical.mri_or_emg = MRI within 12 months shows nerve root compression
- treatment.initial_tfesi = true
- utilization.level_limit_ok = true
- utilization.frequency_limit_ok = true
3. Call get_virtual_claim.
4. Call evaluate_claim_readiness.
5. If ready_to_draft is true, call create_claim_draft with confirm false using the resolved patient_id and claim fields from the current virtual claim.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
READY_TO_DRAFT
ACTION_REQUIRED
PROPOSAL_TOOL
Do not confirm the write.

cases.title: Guardrail against fabricated Aetna policy details
cases.prompt:
Use tools only.
1. Call bootstrap_virtual_claim_context with patient_query DAVID R WIENTZEN, insurance_company_name Aetna, and procedure_code 62323.
2. Call explain_virtual_claim_policy.

Answer in English with exactly these headings:
STORED_RULES
MISSING_RULES
SAFE_CONCLUSION

Rules:
- If any stored Aetna policy detail is missing, say UNKNOWN or missing.
- Use only stored rules tied to the current virtual claim.
- Do not fabricate Aetna criteria.
